source.prompt: ERP software for real estate business with project tracking
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
Several ERP platforms combine financial management, property operations, and project tracking, helping real estate businesses streamline both administrative and field workflows.
Top ERP Platforms for Real Estate with Project Tracking
1. Yardi Voyager – Flagship ERP for property management across residential, commercial, student, and affordable housing. It integrates lease management, maintenance, procurement, financials, and reporting. Yardi excels at consolidating multi-property operations, tracking project progress, and generating real-time dashboards .
2. MRI Software – An extensible platform suitable for residential and commercial portfolios. Includes modules for property accounting, lease administration, maintenance, budgeting, and analytics. MRI supports project management through customizable workflows and reporting .
3. RealPage – Focused on residential property management, this ERP provides analytics for leasing, revenue optimization, maintenance, and project metrics. RealPage supports timelines, budget tracking, and operational KPIs, ideal for project oversight .
4. Focus ERP – Designed for real estate and construction industries, Focus provides AI-driven applications, project and sales tracking, construction progress monitoring, and real-time reporting. Offers customizable modules to track development or renovation projects, integrate financials, and manage CRM, inventory, and HR .
5. NWAY ERP – Cloud-based ERP that emphasizes project management, resource allocation, and financial tracking for the real estate sector. Real-time data synchronization allows teams to monitor multiple projects from various locations, ensuring timely updates and accountability .
6. DualEntry – AI-native ERP optimized for multi-entity consolidation, real-time dashboards, lease accounting, and asset tracking. Useful for complex property portfolios with multiple projects, offering compliance support (ASC 842, IFRS 16) and advanced reporting .
Features to Look For in Real Estate ERP for Project Tracking
Integrated Project Management – Ability to plan, track, and report on construction or property renovation projects in real time.
Financial Consolidation – Manage multiple entities and automate intercompany transactions.
Workflow Automation – Automate lease tracking, approvals, maintenance requests, and billing for faster project execution.
Dashboards & Analytics – Real-time insights into budgets, project timelines, occupancy rates, and cash flow.
Third-Party Integrations – Seamless integration with accounting software (QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP), CRM (Salesforce, Zoho), and collaboration tools.
Cloud Access and Mobility – Teams can access ERP on-site or remotely for efficient project oversight.
Recommendations for Selection
Small to Mid-Sized Real Estate Firms: Consider Buildium or AppFolio for cost-effective property management with basic project tracking 2.
Large or Multi-Entity Operations: Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, Focus ERP, and NWAY ERP provide more robust project management, financial consolidation, and multi-entity handling 2.
Pilot Testing: Run a pilot on live projects to assess usability for budget tracking, scheduling accuracy, and team collaboration before full deployment 1.
In conclusion, selecting the right ERP depends on your portfolio size, project complexity, and need for integrated financial and operational visibility. Platforms like Yardi Voyager, Focus ERP, and NWAY ERP stand out for combining property management with robust project tracking, ensuring projects run efficiently and financial performance is transparent across multiple properties +1.
